in_marathi.name: Parvatam
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parvatam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parvatam is a name of the Hindu goddess Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva. She is the embodiment of love, fertility, and nurturing. In mythology, Parvati is born from a mountain and marries Lord Shiva, who represents destruction and transformation.
